fullTitle: AASM Standards for Accreditation — Service-Based Model Effective 2025
bestFor: Facility requirements for written PSG, MSLT, MWT, PAP and other procedure protocols, infection control, and equipment-cleaning processes.

mappingRationale.D2A: Supports the requirement that technical preparation occurs within written facility procedures.
mappingRationale.D2B: Supports written protocol requirements for test performance.
mappingRationale.D2C: Supports facility procedure and infection-control requirements for response/documentation workflows.
mappingRationale.D3C: Supports facility-level reporting/protocol requirements without replacing scoring rules.
mappingRationale.D4C: Supports written oxygen/other procedure and infection-control requirements where applicable.

authorityBoundary: Use for facility accreditation and written-protocol requirements. It does not replace AASM scoring rules, diagnostic criteria, treatment guidelines, physician orders, state law, facility clinical policy, or manufacturer instructions.
copyrightUse: Use source identity, effective date, public section concepts, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial standards text or protected tables.
